newsitem.title: USA: Mixed bag of corporate debt deals to hit market.
newsitem.headline: Mixed bag of corporate debt deals to hit market.

text.p: Corporate debt issuance on Thursday will consist of a mixed bag of offerings; however, the bulk of paper is seen coming via the private placement arena, dealers said.
Amtran Inc is expected to issue $100 million in seven-year 144a notes on Thursday. Price talk on the issue is seen between 10.50 - 10.75 percent, players said.
American Communications Services is expected to set $170 milion in 10-year 144a senior notes via BT Securities, sources said.
Another $275 million in a three-part debt offering is expected to come to market from Jordan Telecommunications, sources said.
The deal is expected to include $190 million in 10-year 144a notes, $75 millioh (proceeds) in 10-year discount notes, and $20 million of a 12 exchange preferred issue, they said.
Rogers Communications Inc is expected to set $250 million in 10-year debt with price talk seen at 275 basis points over Treasuries, dealers said.
Also, slated for Thursday is Global Ocean Carriers' $125 million 10-year 144a notes, players said.
The benchmark U.S. 30-year Treasury bond is currently yielding 6.48 percent, its lowest level since December, 1996.
Other players speculated that some issuers, with more immediate financing needs, may have taken advantage of earlier windows of opportunity to issue debt.

Meanwhile, one high-grade issuer currently at bat is Hilton Hotels Corp, with its $325 million seven-year debt offering via joint lead managers Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities and JP Morgan Securities, dealers said.
The issue is expected to price at a spread of 89 basis points over Treasuries, syndicate players said.

Hilton's Baa1/BBB-plus rated offering carries a reset provision, which in the event of a downgrade to non-investment grade status, would require the coupon on the issue to be reset as follows, market sources said.
Moody's S&P adjusted spread
Ba1 BB-plus +150
Ba2 BB +185
Ba3 BB-minus +225
B1 or below B-plus or below +300
The coupon reset provision covers a three-year period, source added.
However, analysts said the provision is likely to go unused as such a downgrade would be extremely unlikely given Hilton's deep committment to investment grade ratings.
Proceeds from the offering are expected to be used to repay a portion of borrowings under the firm's commercial paper program, sources said.
Among other offerings, Columbia/HCA Healthcare is expected to issue $200 million 31-year debt via Salomon Brothers Inc, dealers said.
Flemings Cos is expected to issue $500 million in a two-part 144a debt offering via Bear Stearns, syndicate sources said.

Also, Hutchison Whampoa Finance Ltd, a wholly-owned financing subsidiary of Hong Kong-based Hutchison Whampoa Limited, is expected to issue a US$1.0 billion global multi-tranche debt offering, syndicate sources said.
The A3/A-plus rated deal include 10-year, 20-year, 30-year and 40-year maturities, sources said.
Merrill Lynch & Co and Goldman Sachs & Co are expected to jointly underwrite the multi-tranche deal, they said.
The roadshow is expected to be held this week in Hong Kong and next week in New York, syndicate players said.
